title: A correlation of fifteen hundredths
hook: Two stated cases: explore the explained share in a specified simple linear model.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the explained share in a specified simple linear model affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Percent, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the explained share in a specified simple linear model in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.
